Ashwell Circular via Fakeham Walk

Fakeham, the Downs and back

Length

9.87km (6.13 miles), 2 hours 45 minutes. For the whole outing, including trains, sights and meals, allow 6 hours.
Toughness

3 out of 10.
OS Maps

Explorer 999. Ashwell, map reference TQ 000 000, is in Kent, 5km north of Nowhere.
Features

A gentle chalk walk through beech woods to the village of Fakeham, returning along the ridge.

Second paragraph that should not be the summary.
Walk Options
  • At 2km : the detour to the Fox pub in Upper Fakeham adds about 1.5 km to the walk length.
  • At 5km : it is also possible to get a train back to London from Fakeham station.
  • At 8.2 km : you can cut 0.8km off the end of the walk by following the short cut at [*] in the Walk Directions.
Travel

Take the train nearest to 10 am from London Victoria Station to Ashwell . Journey time 42 minutes. Trains back are half-hourly.
By Train

Out (not a train station)

Back (not a train station)

Lunch

The suggested lunch stop is The Fox in Upper Fakeham (tel 01234 567 890), open from 12 noon Wednesday to Sunday as at January 2026. It has a large garden and does children's portions. The detour to this pub adds about 1.5 km to the walk.

Alternatively, 6 km into the walk, The Plough (tel 01234 567 891) in Fakeham serves food until 2.30pm.
Tea

The suggested tea place is the Ashwell Tea Room (tel 01234 567 892), 1 High Street. Last orders 4.30pm; closed on Mondays.

Walk Directions

1. Leave Ashwell station by the exit on platform 2 and turn right along the lane.

2. After 300 metres cross the stile on your left [*] and head up the field edge.

Detour to the Fox

Turn left at the crossroads and the pub is 700 metres ahead.
